texts.zh:
间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告我们位于[snuffedout_country.GetName]附近的特工小队已经错过了几个检查点。考虑到这次行动的性质，我们预料到他们不能维持频繁的联系。然而，虽然感到遗憾，我们的间谍首脑坚信这支小队是失踪了。

如果我们能够成功地掩盖痕迹，[from.GetName]行动可能被挽救。我们得发挥我们的破译对抗[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]的加密的优势。
texts.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that our team of operatives near the [snuffedout_country.GetName] has missed a number of checkpoints. Given the nature of this operation, we had already anticipated them being unable to maintain frequent contact. However, our Spymaster is regrettably confident that by now, the team has been lost.

Operation [from.GetName] may be rescued if we can successfully cover our tracks, pitting our Codebreaking against [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] Encryption.

tooltips.zh:

我们的行动有低到中的几率不会被注意到。被发现几率取决于加密。

如果我们派遣与该行动次要类别相对应的线人，那么成功的概率就会相应地提高。
tooltips.en:
Pauses Operation [from.GetName] for about a month.

There is a medium-to-low chance our actions will go unnoticed, depending on our target's Encryption.

Success is more likely if we have an Asset assigned to this Operation, sharing the same secondary category.

我们的行动有高几率不会被注意到。被发现几率取决于加密。

如果我们派遣与该行动主要类别相对应的线人，那么成功的概率就会相应地提高。
tooltips.en:
Cancels Operation [from.GetName].

There is a high chance our actions will go unnoticed, depending on the target's Encryption.

Success is more likely if we have an Asset assigned to this Operation, sharing the same primary category.

texts.zh:
我们最担心的事情成了真：我们最近在[snuffedout_country.GetName]失去的特工曝光了我们大部分[fromfrom.GetName]行动的细节。

我们的全部间谍网都经过了妥善安排，确保在正常情况下，只有极其不周密的证据才会追溯到我们执行的隐秘行动。然而，在当下的情况，我们完全无法确认何种情报已经泄露；也没法知道[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]打算如何进行回应。
texts.en:
Our worst fears have come to pass: the recent loss of our operatives in the [snuffedout_country.GetName] has exposed large parts of Operation [fromfrom.GetName].

All our Spy Networks are carefully arranged so that under normal circumstances, only very flimsy evidence could ever implicate us in the covert activities we carry out. However, in this instance we cannot be entirely sure what Intel may have been given away; nor can we know how the [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] might choose to respond.

texts.zh:
我们最近在[snuffedout_country.GetName]损失的特工酿成了严重的后果：我方的整个行动被暴露了。

我们的间谍网处于妥善管理的状态，保证正常情况下，能够为我方特工提供一定的匿名性。然而，在当下的情况，我方的任何行动都会导致严重后果，因为各类证据会导向我们，而[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]绝不会对此坐视不管。我们不知道他们会如何回应，得我们应该做好最坏的打算。
texts.en:
The recent loss of our operatives in the [snuffedout_country.GetName] has had some dire consequences: our entire operation has been exposed.

Our Spy Networks are carefully managed so that under normal circumstances, they afford us some level of deniability. However, on this occasion our actions were serious enough that the [snuffedout_country.GetAdj] are unlikely to ignore even circumstantial evidence which may lead back to us. We do not know precisely how they will respond, but we should prepare for the worst.

texts.zh:
我们的加密措施抓获了一帮危险的潜伏者。这些潜在敌人似乎为[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]工作，其阴谋原本会使许多[root.species.GetAdj]人民丧生并对我方造成显著破坏。

我们设法解密了他们携带着的各种材料，但没有一个材料能展现出他们针对我们的计划的全部内容；我们也无法断言他们下一步会做什么。我们获得的情报因而相对较少。

我们必须仔细考虑如何应对。也许我们希望隐藏自身的能力，在星系中的其他邻居面前假装无知。不过，我们也可以正大光明地谴责这次针对我们的未遂暴力袭击。
texts.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of dangerous infiltrators. These would-be hostiles appear to be working on behalf of the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], on a scheme which would have cost many [root.species.GetAdj] lives and caused us significant damage.

We have managed to decrypt various materials they were carrying, however none lays out the full scope of their plans against us; nor are we able to say with certainty what their next move may be. Our Intel gains are therefore relatively small.

We must carefully consider how to respond. We may wish to keep quiet about our own capabilities, feigning ignorance in front of our other galactic neighbors. We would, however, also be justified in publicly denouncing this planned act of violence against us.

texts.zh:
我们的加密措施抓获了一帮危险的潜伏者。这些潜在敌人似乎为[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]工作，其阴谋原本会使许多[root.species.GetAdj]人民丧生并对我方造成显著破坏。

我们从他们身上武力夺取的材料中包括大量通讯日志，并且我们设法解密了日志。没有一份日志描述了他们针对我们的计划的全部内容；[hostile_infiltration_country.GetAdj]的安保看上去至少相当有能量，我们只能获取零星的情报。我们获知的一切消息都算不上可靠。

尽管我们的愤怒来得合理正当，明智来讲我们需要考虑如何回应。我们可能希望隐藏自身的加密能力，在敌人面前假装无能。不过，我们也可以将[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]针对我们的未遂暴力行动公之于众，也许敌人中也会有人对我们表示同情。
texts.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of dangerous infiltrators. These would-be hostiles appear to be working on behalf of the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], on a scheme which would have cost many [root.species.GetAdj] lives and caused us significant damage.

Amongst the materials we forcibly extracted from them were a number of communication logs, which we have managed to decrypt. None describes the full scope of their plans against us; [hostile_infiltration_country.GetAdj] security seems at least capable enough to yield only patchy Intel to us. Everything else we may extract from them is deemed unreliable information.

Despite the justified outrage we may wish to express, we would be wise to consider our response. We could keep quiet about our own Encryption skill, feigning ineptitude in front of our enemies. Were we to expose the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] for this planned act of violence against us, however, we might find those enemies even regarding us with sympathy.

texts.zh:
我们采取的加密措施抓获了一帮匿名但却致命的潜伏者。他们各自宣称为不同的对象效忠，哪一个都没法指望能验明身份。

这些状似特工的[hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]们携带了各式牵连他人的物件，其中有些我们很容易解密。不过，我们怀疑这些东西是伪造的，用来误导或者欺骗我方。这些间谍或许的确替[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]工作，但证据算不上确凿。

以防万一，保持密切地监视[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]或许是值得的。不过，保持沉默或许也有好处，以免走漏我们在安保方面相对虚弱的一面。
texts.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of anonymous, yet deadly infiltrators. They claim various allegiances, none of which we could hope to verify.

These [hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]-looking operatives were carrying various incriminating items, some of which we were easily able to decrypt. We suspect, however, that these items are a fabricated distraction or ruse. These spies may indeed be working for the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], but the evidence is inconclusive.

It may be worthwhile keeping a closer watch on the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], just in case. However, it may also benefit us to keep quiet and not let slip the comparative weakness of our own security.

texts.zh:
我们采取的加密措施抓获了一帮匿名但却致命的潜伏者。他们各自宣称为不同的对象效忠，哪一个都没法指望能验证。

这些状似特工的[hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]们携带了各式牵连他人的物件，其中有些我们很容易解密。不过，我们怀疑这些东西是伪造的，用来误导或者欺骗我方。这些间谍或许的确替[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]工作，但证据算不上确凿。

我们可以对[hostile_infiltration_country.GetName]进行报复——这样的行动甚至会被他国视作正当之举。不过，也有可能整起事件都是个诱饵，用来转移我们对真正敌人的注意力。
texts.en:
Our Encryption measures have caught a band of anonymous, yet deadly infiltrators. Even under interrogation they claim various allegiances, none of which we could hope to verify.

These [hostile_infiltration_country.species.GetName]-looking operatives were carrying various incriminating items, some of which we were easily able to decrypt. We suspect, however, that these items are a fabricated distraction or ruse. These spies may indeed be working for the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName], but the evidence is inconclusive.

We could retaliate against the [hostile_infiltration_country.GetName] - such action may even be deemed justified by others. However, it's possible this entire incident is a clever lure, put in place to distract us from our true enemies.

label.zh: 整个星系都应该听听这个！
label.en: The galaxy shall hear of this!

texts.zh:
[from.GetName]指控我方进行敌对谍报活动。他们的宣称——我方派遣特工从事龌龊的侵略举动——完全是基于谎言、虚假消息和不实的论据之上。

不管理由如何，这一指控导致了[from.GetName]对我们的外交制裁。我们大概不会看到由此带来任何直接后果，但他们的盟友，甚或我们自己的盟友都不会对这种诋毁视而不见。
texts.en:
The [from.GetName] accuses us of hostile espionage. Their claims - that we sent operatives to conduct abhorrent acts of aggression against them - are built upon shaky and misattributed evidence.

Whatever the credibility or reasoning behind this allegation, it has resulted in a diplomatic sanction from the [from.GetName]. We are not likely to see any direct consequences from this, but it's unlikely this smear will go unnoticed by any of their other allies, or even our own.

label.en: It is of no concern to us.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现提出指控的一方名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the party making the accusation appears here.

texts.zh:
我方近来情报行动的目标，[from.GetName]，将我方情报人员当场抓获且要求外交支持。作为交换，他们同意不将我们的隐秘行动公诸星海。

有可能他们的指控并没有实际证据来支撑，但无论如何这一指控本身就足以对我们造成损害。不论动机如何，[from.GetName]已经要求从我方获得政治好处。
texts.en:
Our recent targets of espionage, the [from.GetName], have caught us in the act and demanded political favors. In doing so, they have agreed not to expose our covert actions to the wider galaxy.

It's possible that no actual evidence backs up their claims - the accusation alone could cause us enough damage anyway. Whatever their motivation is, the [from.GetName] have claimed political leverage on us.

texts.zh:
我方近来情报行动的目标，[from.GetName]，不仅看穿了我们的阴谋，还选择将我方行动公之于众！。

有可能他们并没有能够支撑这些指控且可以验证的证据——只有少数国家会选择相信他们。不过，单是这些指控本身可能就足以造成危害了。
texts.en:
Our recent targets of espionage, the [from.GetName], have not only seen through our scheme but have chosen to expose us for our actions!

It's possible that no verifiable evidence backs up these claims - few may choose to believe them. The accusation alone may be damaging enough, however.

texts.zh:
我方近来情报行动的目标，[from.GetName]，不仅看穿了我们的阴谋，还选择将我方的敌对行动公之于众！。

有可能他们并未对此掌握实际证据——他们也许只是试图虚张声势来侮辱我们，或者是从他们在星系中的邻居那里赢取支持。
texts.en:
Our recent targets of espionage, the [from.GetName], have not only seen through our scheme but have decided to expose us for our actions against them.

It's possible that they hold no actual evidence for this - they may simply try to bluff their way to insulting us or earning favor with their galactic neighbors.

label.en: Two can play at that game.

texts.zh:
尽管耗费了大量人力物力，消耗了许多间谍首脑[fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]在[snuffedout_country.GetName]积累的成果，我们终于确保了行动的安全性。所有松动的口子都被堵上；所有掩护身份都被抛弃掉。一支全新的特工队伍将替代原来的人员，在我们的间谍首脑亲自注视下执行着完全不同指令。

与此同时，[snuffedout_country.GetAdj]依然没有注意到我方的存在。
texts.en:
Though it has greatly taxed the resources of Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName]'s work in the [snuffedout_country.GetName], operational security has been reasserted. All loose ends have been covered; all cover identities discarded. A new team of operatives will take over from here, enacting a subtly different set of orders under our Spymaster's watchful gaze.

The [snuffedout_country.GetAdj], meanwhile, still seem oblivious to our presence.

有可能私下里，[fromfrom.target.GetName]依然将我们的正当理由视作一通子鬼话。但只要双方还在意面子：我们的身份就会被视作是“清白”的。
texts.en:
Spymaster [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetName] and [fromfrom.spynetwork.leader.GetHisHer] colleagues have smoothed over our operatives' awkward intrusion into the [fromfrom.target.GetName].

It's possible that in private, the [fromfrom.target.GetName] sees our excuses for the pack of lies they are. As far as outward appearances are concerned, however: we are considered to be 'in the clear'.

texts.zh:
我们已经通过外交斡旋解决了我们侵入[fromfrom.target.GetName]所引起的一些外交误会。

有可能私下里，[fromfrom.target.GetName]依然将我们的正当理由视作一通子鬼话。但只要双方还在意面子：我们的身份就会被视作是“清白”的。
texts.en:
We have successfully negotiated our way out of the diplomatically awkward intrusion into the [fromfrom.target.GetName].

It's possible that in private, the [fromfrom.target.GetName] does not lend any credibility to our excuses at all, but from an outside perspective: we are considered to be 'in the clear' for now.

summary.text:
# 被[patrol_drone]拘押 / Apprehended by patrol drones

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nemesis_operations_events_1.txt, common/scripted_effects/espionage_event_effects.txt, common/espionage_operation_types/operations.txt · DLC：Nemesis · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

行动失手随机事件：间谍行动某一阶段的检定失败时，on_roll_failed 调用 standard_espionage_operation_on_roll_failed（common/scripted_effects/espionage_event_effects.txt:2331-2386）：每次失败有 1/40 的几率（39:1）从该行动类型指定的事件池中抽一件，且同一行动 90 天内只触发一次。事件池按双方帝国类型（普通/集体意识）选择（:2390-2821）。
Mishap: when an operation stage roll fails, on_roll_failed calls standard_espionage_operation_on_roll_failed, which has a 1-in-40 chance to draw one event from the pool named by the operation type (at most one per 90 days per operation); pools are chosen by empire kinds.
本事件进入的事件池：
- 普通对集体意识（权重1，行动 5010，EF:2508）；集体对集体意识（机械帝国除外，EF:2577）；低风险池中“普通对集体意识”（EF:2717）。
Pools containing it:
regular -> gestalt; gestalt -> gestalt (not for machine owners); low-stakes pool.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

5010：特工被目标的巡逻无人机盯上。选项：a 寄望外交（友好程度越高越安全；可能引出 5035“扼杀”或 5011“外交解决”）；b 使用线人（行动恢复，直接 5011）。5035 之后同“特工受惊”。
5010: the operatives are noticed by patrol drones; (a) trust in diplomacy -> 5011 or the Snuffed Out chain, (b) use the Asset -> 5011.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- a 选项三个版本按目标是否友好、是否有间谍网络等条件出现。

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 友好度越高越不容易出事。 The friendlier the target, the smaller the risk.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：5010、5011 与事件池条件。
